```{=html}
<!-- Hero cartográfico dinámico: MapLibre se mantiene bajo el manto. -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/maplibre-gl.css">
<style>
.page-layout-custom#quarto-content {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A);
}

body:has(.cl-home) {
  background: var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A);
}

body:has(.cl-home) footer.footer {
  display: none;
}

.cl-home {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  height: calc(100svh - 3.5rem);
  min-height: calc(100svh - 3.5rem);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A);
  color: #fff;
}

.cl-home::before,
.cl-home::after {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  content: "";
  pointer-events: none;
}

#cl-hero-map {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  background: transparent;
}

.cl-map-place {
  color: rgb(14 79 90 / 72%);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  line-height: 1;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none;
}

#cl-hero-map .maplibregl-canvas {
  opacity: 1;
}

#cl-hero-map .maplibregl-ctrl-attrib {
  background: rgb(5 48 56 / 38%);
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 82%);
  font-size: 10px;
  opacity: .88;
}

#cl-hero-map .maplibregl-ctrl-attrib a {
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 92%);
}

.cl-home::before {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A) 0,
      var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A) 2rem,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A) 96%, transparent) 6rem,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A) 82%, transparent) 12rem,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A) 55%, transparent) 20rem,
      transparent 30rem
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A) 44%, transparent),
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A) 44%, transparent)
    );
}

.cl-home::after {
  background:
    linear-gradient(0deg, rgb(0 0 0 / 38%), transparent 46%),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0 27 32 / 40%), rgb(0 27 32 / 18%) 48%, transparent 70%);
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 14rem, #000 26rem);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 14rem, #000 26rem);
}

.cl-home-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  width: min(calc(100% - 3rem), 82rem);
  height: 100%;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-block: clamp(4rem, 9vh, 7rem);
  align-items: center;
}

.cl-home-copy {
  width: 66.666%;
  max-width: 54rem;
}

.cl-home .cl-kicker {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 62%);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.cl-home h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: clamp(4.8rem, 9vw, 8rem);
  font-weight: 200;
  letter-spacing: -0.065em;
  line-height: .86;
}

.cl-home-slogan {
  max-width: 43rem;
  margin: 1.6rem 0 0;
  border: 0;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.7vw, 3.35rem);
  font-weight: 300;
  letter-spacing: -.045em;
  line-height: 1.02;
}

.cl-prompt-demo {
  display: flex;
  width: min(100%, 39rem);
  min-height: 2.8rem;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  border: 0;
  border-left: 2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 52%);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(0 0 0 / 14%), transparent 88%);
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 88%);
  font-size: clamp(0.88rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.35;
  padding: 0.62rem 0.9rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.cl-prompt-mark {
  margin-right: 0.65rem;
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 55%);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.cl-prompt-text::after {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1em;
  margin-left: 0.2rem;
  background: currentColor;
  content: "";
  vertical-align: -0.12em;
  animation: cl-cursor 0.9s steps(1) infinite;
}

@keyframes cl-cursor {
  50% { opacity: 0; }
}

.cl-home-lead {
  max-width: 39rem;
  margin: 1.3rem 0 0;
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 86%);
  font-size: 1.03rem;
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.cl-home .cl-story-actions {
  margin-top: 2rem;
}

.cl-home .cl-story-cta,
.cl-home .cl-story-link {
  border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 42%);
  background: rgb(0 0 0 / 10%);
  color: #fff !important;
  font-weight: 400;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.cl-home .cl-story-cta:hover,
.cl-home .cl-story-cta:focus-visible,
.cl-home .cl-story-link:hover,
.cl-home .cl-story-link:focus-visible {
  border-color: #fff;
  background: #fff;
  color: var(--censolab-primary, #0E4F5A) !important;
}

@media (max-width: 899.98px) {
  .cl-home {
    height: auto;
  }

  .cl-home-inner {
    height: auto;
    min-height: calc(100svh - 3.5rem);
  }

  .cl-home-copy {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .cl-home-inner {
    width: calc(100% - 2.5rem);
    padding-block: 3.5rem;
  }

  .cl-home h1 {
    font-size: clamp(4rem, 21vw, 5.7rem);
  }

  .cl-prompt-demo {
    min-height: 4rem;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .cl-prompt-text::after {
    animation: none;
  }
}
</style>

<main class="cl-home">
  <div id="cl-hero-map" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="cl-home-inner">
    <div class="cl-home-copy">
      <p class="cl-kicker" aria-hidden="true">&nbsp;</p>
      <h1>CensoLab</h1>
      <h2 class="cl-home-slogan unanchored">Pregúntale a los datos. Descubre tu territorio.</h2>
      <div class="cl-prompt-demo" aria-label="Ejemplos de consultas que puedes hacer en CensoLab">
        <span class="cl-prompt-mark" aria-hidden="true">›</span>
        <span class="cl-prompt-text" aria-hidden="true">Muéstrame la cantidad de habitantes por comuna para la región del Biobío</span>
      </div>
      <p class="cl-home-lead">Explora la información censal usando lenguaje natural. CensoLab convierte tus preguntas en respuestas claras, cálculos y visualizaciones construidas con los datos.</p>
      <div class="cl-story-actions">
        <a class="cl-story-cta" href="app/">Ir a CensoLab</a>
        <a class="cl-story-link" href="como-usar/">Ver cómo funciona</a>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</main>

<script src="assets/maplibre-gl.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  document.querySelector('.navbar-toggler[role="menu"]')?.removeAttribute('role');
  document.querySelector('.cl-home-slogan')?.classList.remove('anchored');

  const promptText = document.querySelector('.cl-prompt-text');
  const promptExamples = [
    'Muéstrame la cantidad de habitantes por comuna para la región del Biobío',
    'Grafica escolaridad promedio vs. conexión a internet de las comunas de Valparaíso',
    'Dame el informe territorial de Isla de Maipo',
    'Cuéntame una historia sobre el envejecimiento en Chile'
  ];
  const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  if (promptText && !reducedMotion) {
    let promptIndex = 0;
    let characterIndex = promptExamples[0].length;
    let deleting = true;

    const typePrompt = () => {
      const phrase = promptExamples[promptIndex];

      if (deleting) {
        characterIndex -= 1;
      } else {
        characterIndex += 1;
      }

      promptText.textContent = phrase.slice(0, characterIndex);

      if (!deleting && characterIndex === phrase.length) {
        deleting = true;
        window.setTimeout(typePrompt, 2200);
        return;
      }

      if (deleting && characterIndex === 0) {
        deleting = false;
        promptIndex = (promptIndex + 1) % promptExamples.length;
        window.setTimeout(typePrompt, 320);
        return;
      }

      window.setTimeout(typePrompt, deleting ? 18 : 38);
    };

    window.setTimeout(typePrompt, 2200);
  }

  const container = document.getElementById('cl-hero-map');
  if (!container || !window.maplibregl) return;

  const places = [
    { center: [-70.31, -18.48], zoom: 7.1, bearing: -8 },
    { center: [-70.40, -23.65], zoom: 6.7, bearing: 7 },
    { center: [-71.25, -29.95], zoom: 6.5, bearing: -5 },
    { center: [-70.67, -33.45], zoom: 7.0, bearing: 4 },
    { center: [-73.05, -36.82], zoom: 6.8, bearing: -7 },
    { center: [-72.94, -41.47], zoom: 6.4, bearing: 6 },
    { center: [-72.68, -45.57], zoom: 6.2, bearing: -5 },
    { center: [-70.91, -53.16], zoom: 6.5, bearing: 8 }
  ];

  const chileLabels = [
    { name: 'Arica', coordinates: [-70.31, -18.48] },
    { name: 'Antofagasta', coordinates: [-70.40, -23.65] },
    { name: 'Copiapó', coordinates: [-70.33, -27.37] },
    { name: 'La Serena', coordinates: [-71.25, -29.90] },
    { name: 'Santiago', coordinates: [-70.67, -33.45] },
    { name: 'Concepción', coordinates: [-73.05, -36.82] },
    { name: 'Puerto Montt', coordinates: [-72.94, -41.47] },
    { name: 'Coyhaique', coordinates: [-72.07, -45.57] },
    { name: 'Punta Arenas', coordinates: [-70.91, -53.16] }
  ];

  let current = 3;
  let timer;

  const initialView = {
    ...places[current],
    center: [-78.84, -33.64],
    zoom: 4,
    bearing: 0
  };

  const cameraOffset = () => [
    container.clientWidth >= 900 ? Math.min(container.clientWidth * 0.2, 300) : 0,
    Math.min(container.clientHeight * 0.06, 64)
  ];

  const map = new maplibregl.Map({
    container,
    style: {
      version: 8,
      sources: {
        carto: {
          type: 'vector',
          url: 'https://tiles.basemaps.cartocdn.com/vector/carto.streets/v1/tiles.json',
          attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://carto.com/about-carto/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CARTO</a> · &copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/about/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors · CensoLab'
        }
      },
      layers: [
        {
          id: 'territory-background',
          type: 'background',
          paint: { 'background-color': '#f4f4f1' }
        },
        {
          id: 'territory-water',
          type: 'fill',
          source: 'carto',
          'source-layer': 'water',
          paint: { 'fill-color': '#d9e4e7' }
        },
        {
          id: 'territory-state-boundaries',
          type: 'line',
          source: 'carto',
          'source-layer': 'boundary',
          minzoom: 4,
          filter: ['all', ['==', 'admin_level', 4], ['==', 'maritime', 0]],
          paint: {
            'line-color': '#90a5aa',
            'line-width': ['interpolate', ['linear'], ['zoom'], 4, 0.45, 8, 0.9],
            'line-opacity': 0.72
          }
        },
        {
          id: 'territory-country-boundaries',
          type: 'line',
          source: 'carto',
          'source-layer': 'boundary',
          filter: ['all', ['==', 'admin_level', 2], ['==', 'maritime', 0]],
          paint: {
            'line-color': '#607d84',
            'line-width': ['interpolate', ['linear'], ['zoom'], 4, 0.8, 8, 1.4],
            'line-opacity': 0.78
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    center: initialView.center,
    zoom: initialView.zoom,
    bearing: initialView.bearing,
    pitch: 18,
    interactive: false,
    attributionControl: false,
    renderWorldCopies: false,
    fadeDuration: 0
  });

  map.addControl(new maplibregl.AttributionControl({ compact: false }), 'bottom-right');

  const travel = () => {
    let next = current;
    while (next === current) next = Math.floor(Math.random() * places.length);
    current = next;

    map.flyTo({
      ...places[current],
      offset: cameraOffset(),
      pitch: 18,
      duration: 3200,
      curve: 0.9,
      essential: false
    });
  };

  map.once('load', () => {
    map.jumpTo({
      ...initialView,
      offset: cameraOffset(),
      pitch: 18
    });

    chileLabels.forEach(({ name, coordinates }) => {
      const label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'cl-map-place';
      label.textContent = name;
      const marker = new maplibregl.Marker({ element: label, anchor: 'center' })
        .setLngLat(coordinates)
        .addTo(map);
      const markerElement = marker.getElement();
      markerElement.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      markerElement.setAttribute('role', 'presentation');
      markerElement.removeAttribute('aria-label');
      markerElement.removeAttribute('tabindex');
    });

    if (!reducedMotion) timer = window.setInterval(travel, 7000);
  });

  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => {
    if (timer) window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, { once: true });
})();
</script>
```
